title: Keyboard Layout
menu.field: Fix the layout in the message field
toast.nothing: Nothing to change: no letters to switch
toast.usage: Type the text after the command: /fix ghbdtn
settings.direction.auto: By the letters of the text
settings.keep_links.about: They are usually pasted, not typed, so they are right already.
settings.try.about: Type some text and see it in the other layout.
settings.edit_own: Fix my own messages in place
settings.edit_own.about: “Fix the layout” in the menu of your message edits it. Formatting in it, if any, is lost.
settings.show_result.about: Someone else's message is always copied in the other layout; with this on it is also shown in a window.
settings.where.about: The message field: chat menu (⋮) → Plugins, or right click on the send button to send it fixed at once. A message: its own menu.
